Title: LSJ: Flash Grenade & Mass Reality Question

Messages.Author: Xarei
Messages.Body:
I have read a couple of threads regarding Flash Grenade and its
complexities, but I have some questions that I haven't found addressed
previously.

1. Does Mass Reality make Flash Grenade do damage? (On the one hand
they are weapons, but on the other hand they didn't do damage in the
first place so I don't know)

2. If the answer to 1 is yes, when does that damage happen? (It would
seem that it would happen at the same time as the damage done by
Catatonic Fear, but WOW does that make this a nasty combo)

Thanks...

PS here's the card text for the convenience of all:

Flash Grenade
Weapon.
Strike: combat ends. If the opposing minion is a vampire, he or she is
tapped and does not untap as normal on his or her next untap phase. If
the bearer is a vampire and the grenade is used at close range, the
bearer is also tapped and does not untap as normal on his or her next
untap phase. Burn this weapon after use.

Mass Reality
Cardtype: Action
Cost: 2 blood
Discipline: Chimerstry
[chi] Put this card in play. Weapons possessed by minions you control
inflict +1 damage each strike. Any minion may burn this card as a (D)
action.
[CHI] As above, but the weapons inflict +2 damage each strike.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Xarei wrote:

> I have read a couple of threads regarding Flash Grenade and its
> complexities, but I have some questions that I haven't found addressed
> previously.
>
> 1. Does Mass Reality make Flash Grenade do damage? (On the one hand
> they are weapons, but on the other hand they didn't do damage in the
> first place so I don't know)

No.
Adding damage to strikes which are not damage dealing strikes will not deal
damage (e.g., using Lucky Blow and choosing your Rowan Ring melee weapon
won't deal damage) [RTR 19960221]
